messages:
sara: Quick sync: OrionCloud wants ap-southeast-4 live next week. We need to coordinate marketplace entitlements, Dedicated quota, and the joint press blurb. Who can own end-to-end?

tom: I can drive entitlements + ops handoff. Need SKU mapping and the expected peak qps.

sara: SKU candidates below and expected load: peak 60k qps burst, steady 7k qps. Dedicated desired: 6 nodes (A100-equivalent). Fallback to shared with strict quotas.

kai (OrionCloud): Confirming those numbers. Orion will provide BYOK KMS and a peering subnet. We need the Redwood KMS manifest + minimal IAM doc.

olga: Legal: I need the reseller addendum + export checklist. I can draft addendum in ~24h after product term confirmation. Also need to confirm marketing copy for joint announcement.

sara: Marketing note: keep initial blurb high-level. Product to review before send. Tom - post SKUs in the ticket and tag @deploy-bot.

Tom: SKUs (proposed):
```
orion.apac.edge.s
orion.apac.edge.m
orion.apac.edge.dedicated-6
```
Opening entitlement ticket now -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ORION-APAC-456

deploy-bot: created ORION-APAC-456 assigned to tom; due 2026-04-02

nate (dedicated-infra): We can carve 4 dedicated nodes immediately. Remaining 2 require PO or committed reserved capacity. If marketing needs a date, call out phased capacity.

sara: Phased is fine. We should publish as "available with optional dedicated capacity" and update listing when Dedicated is live.

kai (OrionCloud): We'll run a light load test Wed 02:00 UTC. SRE will share results. Also pushing vendor HW certs to ticket.

olga: Export control quick-check: vendor certs + country sanctions list needed. If certs arrive by Tue noon, I can clear.

Tom: Added KMS request and peering template to ORION-APAC-456. Tagging nate, olga, kai.

sre-bot: scheduled load test job #845, ETA Wed 02:00 UTC, results will post to ticket.

kai (OrionCloud): Mike from Orion SRE will run the test and post perf logs.

sara: Ok next steps: 1) Tom track entitlement ticket, 2) Olga draft addendum, 3) Nate reserve 4 nodes + confirm PO path, 4) Kai run load test and attach certs. We'll reconvene Fri EOD for go/no-go.

olga: On it. Drafting addendum now.

tom: I'll keep the ticket updated. If anyone needs a temporary quota increase for shared tier for validation, ping me here.

sara: Thanks team — call out blockers here. :rocket:
